summary: An aide notices how an electricity bill changes a client’s evening at home.
realLife: Adams described a client who switched the lights off at seven in the evening to save money, giving up activities such as reading.
gates: The resident disclosed the reason for the routine or a record confirms it.
inGame: needs: a household account of reducing electricity use to save money.

turns.what: The resident leaves a reading light on.
turns.pulledBy: A lower bill or assistance payment makes the usual evening affordable.

turns.what: The resident keeps one room lit.
turns.pulledBy: The household can afford limited use.
